name: Aquaguard Enrich Superio
summary: Aquaguard Enrich Superio RO+UV+SS 2X is a premium 9-stage water purifier featuring advanced RO+UV purification, NanoPore 2X technology, and a hygienic SS304 stainless steel tank.
intro: Aquaguard Enrich Superio RO+UV+SS 2X is a premium 9-stage RO+UV water purifier with NanoPore 2X technology, a hygienic SS304 stainless steel tank, and 3-in-1 Active Copper Mineraliser. Designed for borewell, tanker, and municipal water (TDS up to 2000 mg/L), it delivers safe, mineral-rich drinking water with a long-lasting 2-year filter life and efficient water-saving performance.
features: NanoPore 2X Technology removes heavy metals, pesticides, and microplastics
2-Year Filter Life (up to 6000 litres under standard conditions)
SS304 Stainless Steel Tank for hygienic, corrosion-free storage
3-in-1 Active Copper Technology enriches water with Copper, Calcium & Magnesium
Mega Sediment Filter protects internal filters by removing dirt and sediments
UV e-Boiling Technology ensures microbiologically safe drinking water
More than 40% Water Recovery for reduced water wastage
Suitable for Borewell, Tanker & Municipal Water
